ITEM PARAGRAPHS
Everybody
needs
fresh
water
.
Without
water
,
people
,
animals
and
plants
cannot
live
.
Although
a
few
plants
and
animals
can
make
do
with
saltwater
,
all
humans
need
a
constant
supply
of
fresh
water
if
they
are
to
stay
fit
and
healthy
.
Of
the
total
supply
of
water
on
the
Earth
,
only
about
3
percent
of
it
is
fresh
,
and
most
of
that
is
stored
as
ice
and
snow
at
the
poles
,

so
deep
under

surface
of
the
Earth
that
we
cannot
get
to
